Method of Attack: Uses hard drive's LED to flicker at rapid intervals to exfiltrate data via light signals
Malware encodes sensitive data into binary using LED flickers
Data captured by nearby cameras or photodiode sensors and decoded
Exfiltration of sensitive data such as keystrokes, encryption keys, user credentials
Attack designed for air-gapped systems without internet connection
Discoverer: Cyber Security Research Center at the Ben-Gurion University of the Negev in Israel
Impacted Systems: Air-gapped computers with HDD activity LEDs
Attack Vector: Infection of offline computers with custom malware that controls HDD LED
Indicators of Compromise: Rapid flickering of HDD LED not typical of normal activity
